edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the sender of transfer/transferFrom when forwarded to _transferFrom.
approve writes _allowances[msg.sender][spender].
isOwner compares msg.sender with owner and backs the onlyOwner modifier.
setShare is gated by onlyToken, requiring msg.sender == _token.
claimDividend() uses msg.sender as the holder forwarded to the distributor.
block.timestamp is consumed as the swap deadline in swapBack.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
inSwap guard short-circuits _transferFrom into _basicTransfer.
transfer delegates to _transferFrom.
transferFrom delegates to _transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and decrements the caller allowance.
_transferFrom falls back to _basicTransfer while inSwap is true.
_transferFrom triggers swapBack when the recipient is the pair and the contract holds tokens.
_transferFrom applies takeFee when shouldTakeFee returns true.
_transferFrom debits the sender and credits the recipient in _balances.
_transferFrom performs an external distributor.setShare call before finishing state updates.
swapBack performs an external router swap call before sending ETH out.
swapBack forwards half of the ETH balance to the marketing wallet.
swapBack forwards half of the ETH balance to the treasury.
The swapping modifier sets and clears the inSwap reentrancy guard around swapBack.
_setIsDividendExempt calls distributor.setShare to sync the exemption.
setShare settles pending dividends via distributeDividend before updating the share.
claimDividend invokes distributeDividend for the shareholder.
distributeDividend pushes ETH to the shareholder with transfer, an external callback point.
DividendDistributor.manualSend pushes the contract ETH balance to an owner-chosen holder.
claimDividend() forwards to distributor.claimDividend(msg.sender).
Owner-only claimDividend(holder) forwards to distributor.claimDividend.
setTreasury also updates the treasury stored in the distributor.
manualSend transfers the entire ETH balance to the marketing wallet.
transferOwnership rewrites owner and is protected by onlyOwner.
setFee writes totalFee and is protected by onlyOwner plus a 14 percent cap.
setBot writes isBot and is protected by onlyOwner.
setBulkBots writes isBot in a loop and is protected by onlyOwner.
delBulkBots writes isBot in a loop and is protected by onlyOwner.
The constructor deploys DividendDistributor and stores it in distributor.
The constructor fixes the owner to a hardcoded address through Auth.
The constructor creates and stores the router pair.
The constructor mints the whole supply to the owner in _balances.
deposit divides by totalShares when accumulating dividendsPerShare.
deposit increases the dividendsPerShare accumulator.
takeFee credits the collected fee to the contract balance.
_basicTransfer moves balances without fee logic.
The amount parameter drives the balance subtraction and fee math in _transferFrom.
The sender parameter indexes _balances in _transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is credited in _transferFrom and checked against isBot.
recipient == pair is the condition that triggers swapBack.
The shareholder parameter keys the shares mapping in setShare.
amountReceived (post-fee amount) is written back into the recipient balance.
amountToSwap becomes the token input of the router swap.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries the value used in the balance and fee computations of _transferFrom, so it should be folded into that function.
The sender parameter is a transient alias for the account whose _balances entry is debited inside _transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is a transient alias for the credited account and the swapBack trigger inside _transferFrom.
The shareholder parameter is only used to key the shares mapping and settle dividends in setShare.
amountReceived is a short-lived local that is immediately written into _balances inside _transferFrom.
amountToSwap is a short-lived local holding the contract balance consumed by the swap call in swapBack.
